name: tic-tac-toe-rl
title: Reinforcement Learning for Tic-Tac-Toe: From Minimax to DQN

parts.title: Board Representation & Game Engine
parts.description: Encode the 3x3 board, move legality, win/draw detection, turn tracking, and a Game class.

parts.title: Random and Minimax Baselines
parts.description: A random agent, head-to-head rollouts, and full minimax with alpha-beta pruning.

parts.title: Tabular Q-Learning Foundations
parts.description: State hashing with symmetry, hyperparameters, epsilon-greedy, rewards, and the Q-update loop.

parts.title: Self-Play, Evaluation & Persistence
parts.description: Self-play with perspective flipping, evaluation vs random/minimax, and Q-table save/load.

parts.title: Deep Q-Network Agent
parts.description: Board encodings, an MLP with backprop, replay buffer, target network, and DQN training.

parts.title: Policy Gradients & Extensions
parts.description: SARSA, REINFORCE, value-vs-policy comparison, and 8-fold symmetry data augmentation.

steps.name: create_empty_board
steps.doc: A fresh 3x3 board of zeros (all cells empty).

steps.name: encode_player
steps.doc: Map a player symbol to its board mark: 'X' -> +1, 'O' -> -1.

steps.name: print_board
steps.doc: Render the board as a string using X / O / . , rows on separate lines.

steps.name: is_cell_empty
steps.doc: True if the cell at action 0..8 is empty.

steps.name: place_move
steps.doc: Return a NEW board with ``player``'s mark placed at ``action`` (no mutation).

steps.name: get_legal_moves
steps.doc: List of empty action indices (0..8).

steps.name: check_row_win
steps.doc: True if ``player`` occupies a full row.

steps.name: check_column_win
steps.doc: True if ``player`` occupies a full column.

steps.name: check_main_diagonal_win
steps.doc: True if ``player`` occupies the main (top-left to bottom-right) diagonal.

steps.name: check_anti_diagonal_win
steps.doc: True if ``player`` occupies the anti (top-right to bottom-left) diagonal.

steps.name: is_winner
steps.doc: True if ``player`` has any winning line (row, column, or diagonal).

steps.name: is_draw
steps.doc: True if the board is full and neither player has won.

steps.name: get_game_status
steps.doc: Game outcome: +1 (X wins), -1 (O wins), 0 (draw), or None (still in play).

steps.name: get_current_player
steps.doc: Whose turn it is: +1 if X and O have played equally (X starts), else -1.

steps.name: switch_player
steps.doc: The other player: +1 <-> -1.

steps.name: play_hardcoded_game
steps.doc: Play a fixed list of actions, alternating from X, and return the final board.

steps.name: play_interactive_game
steps.doc:
Play to termination, asking ``get_move(board, player)`` for each action.
Returns the final game status (+1 / -1 / 0). ``get_move`` makes this testable
without real stdin (pass a scripted callback).

steps.name: TicTacToeGame
steps.doc:
A reusable game object wrapping the functional engine.

Attributes: ``board`` (3x3) and ``current_player`` (+1/-1).
Methods: reset(), legal_moves(), step(action) -> status, status().

steps.name: random_move_agent
steps.doc: Pick a uniformly random legal action using ``rng`` (a numpy Generator).

steps.name: play_random_vs_random_game
steps.doc: Play one game with both sides random; return the final status (+1/-1/0).

steps.name: play_random_vs_random_matches
steps.doc: Play ``n_games`` random-vs-random games; return the list of statuses.

steps.name: compute_outcome_rates
steps.doc: Fraction of X wins / O wins / draws from a list of statuses.

steps.name: minimax_terminal_score
steps.doc: Score of a terminal board from X's perspective: +1 X win, -1 O win, 0 draw.

steps.name: minimax_recursive
steps.doc:
Exact minimax value of ``board`` with ``player`` to move (X maximizes). Uses
a transposition table (positions reachable many ways are scored once).

steps.name: minimax_max_min_step
steps.doc: Combine child values: the maximizer (X, +1) takes max, the minimizer (O) min.

steps.name: minimax_best_move
steps.doc:
The action with the optimal minimax value for ``player`` (first if tied).
Scores all candidate moves with one shared transposition table.

steps.name: minimax_alpha_beta
steps.doc: Minimax value with alpha-beta pruning (same result as minimax_recursive).

steps.name: play_minimax_vs_random_matches
steps.doc:
Minimax (X) vs random (O). Minimax should never lose; returns statuses.
Move selection uses alpha-beta (same as minimax, just faster).

steps.name: play_minimax_vs_minimax_matches
steps.doc: Minimax vs minimax — always a draw with optimal play; returns statuses.

steps.name: encode_board_state_key
steps.doc: A hashable key for a board: the tuple of its 9 cells (row-major).

steps.name: canonical_board_key
steps.doc:
Canonical key under the board's 8 symmetries (4 rotations x mirror): the
lexicographically smallest cell-tuple over all transforms. Shrinks the state space.

steps.name: initialize_q_table
steps.doc: An empty Q-table (dict mapping state key -> length-9 action-value array).

steps.name: get_q_value
steps.doc: Q(state, action), defaulting to 0.0 for unseen states.

steps.name: set_q_value
steps.doc: Set Q(state, action) (creating a zero row for unseen states); return the table.

steps.name: choose_learning_rate_alpha
steps.doc: A sensible tabular learning rate.

steps.name: choose_discount_factor_gamma
steps.doc: A sensible discount factor.

steps.name: choose_initial_epsilon
steps.doc: Start fully exploratory.

steps.name: epsilon_decay_schedule
steps.doc: Multiplicative epsilon decay with a floor.

steps.name: epsilon_greedy_explore_move
steps.doc: The explore branch: a uniformly random legal move.

steps.name: epsilon_greedy_select_action
steps.doc: With prob epsilon explore a random legal move, else act greedily.

steps.name: greedy_argmax_over_legal_actions
steps.doc: The legal action with the highest Q-value (first if tied).

steps.name: random_tie_break_argmax
steps.doc: Argmax index with ties broken uniformly at random.

steps.name: tic_tac_toe_reward
steps.doc: Reward for ``player`` given a game status: +1 win, -1 loss, 0 otherwise.

steps.name: q_learning_nonterminal_target
steps.doc: TD target with bootstrapping: r + gamma * max_a' Q(s', a').

steps.name: q_learning_terminal_target
steps.doc: TD target at a terminal state: just the reward (no bootstrap).

steps.name: q_learning_update
steps.doc: Q-learning update: Q <- Q + alpha * (target - Q).

steps.name: episode_reset_game
steps.doc: Start-of-episode board.

steps.name: episode_agent_pick_action
steps.doc: The agent's action for this step (epsilon-greedy).

steps.name: episode_apply_action
steps.doc: Apply an action; return (next_board, status).

steps.name: episode_apply_q_update
steps.doc: Apply one Q-learning update for (state_key, action) toward ``target``.

steps.name: episode_check_terminate
steps.doc: Whether the episode has ended.

steps.name: train_q_learning_agent
steps.doc:
Train a Q-learning agent (X) against a random opponent (O). Returns
(q_table, episode_rewards) where rewards are the agent's terminal rewards.

steps.name: compute_batched_outcome_stats
steps.doc: Win/loss/draw rates for ``perspective`` (+1 or -1) over a list of statuses.

steps.name: self_play_episode
steps.doc:
Run one self-play training episode (the agent plays both sides, learning
from each via perspective flipping). Mutates and returns (q_table, status).

steps.name: flip_board_perspective
steps.doc:
View the board from ``player``'s side: multiply by player so the mover's
pieces are always +1. One Q-table can then serve both sides.

steps.name: perspective_reward_sign
steps.doc: Sign to convert an X-perspective reward to ``player``'s perspective (+1/-1).

steps.name: train_q_agent_self_play
steps.doc: Train via self-play for ``n_episodes``; return (q_table, statuses).

steps.name: evaluate_q_agent_vs_random
steps.doc: Greedy agent (X) vs random (O); return win/loss/draw stats from X's view.

steps.name: evaluate_q_agent_vs_minimax
steps.doc:
Greedy agent (X) vs optimal minimax (O); return stats from X's view.
Against optimal play the agent can never win (best case is a draw).

steps.name: inspect_q_values_for_state
steps.doc: The length-9 vector of Q-values for a board (zeros for unseen states).

steps.name: serialize_q_table_to_dict
steps.doc: Convert a Q-table to a JSON-serializable {comma-joined key: list} dict.

steps.name: deserialize_q_table_from_dict
steps.doc: Inverse of serialize_q_table_to_dict.

steps.name: encode_board_flat_length_nine
steps.doc: Flatten the board to a length-9 float vector.

steps.name: encode_board_one_hot_length_eighteen
steps.doc: Two channels per cell: [is_X, is_O], flattened to length 18.

steps.name: build_mlp_architecture
steps.doc: Layer sizes for a 1-hidden-layer MLP: [input, hidden, output].

steps.name: initialize_mlp_parameters
steps.doc: He-initialized parameters {W1,b1,W2,b2} for the architecture.

steps.name: mlp_forward_pass
steps.doc: Forward pass of the MLP: relu(x@W1+b1)@W2+b2. x is (batch, input_dim).

steps.name: mask_illegal_actions_neg_inf
steps.doc: Set Q-values of illegal (occupied) cells to -inf so they're never chosen.

steps.name: argmax_action_from_q_values
steps.doc: The action with the highest Q-value.

steps.name: mse_loss_on_chosen_action
steps.doc:
Mean squared error on the taken action only (DQN updates that action).
q_pred (batch,9), actions (batch,), targets (batch,).

steps.name: mlp_backward_pass
steps.doc: Gradients of the chosen-action MSE loss. Returns {W1,b1,W2,b2}.

steps.name: adam_update_step
steps.signature: adam_update_step(params, grads, state, lr=0.001, betas=(0.9, 0.999), eps=1e-08)
steps.doc:
One Adam step over the parameter dict. ``state`` is None on the first call.
Returns (new_params, state).

steps.name: create_replay_buffer
steps.doc: An empty replay buffer (list of transitions).

steps.name: append_transition_to_buffer
steps.doc: Append a (state, action, reward, next_state, done) transition; return buffer.

steps.name: cap_buffer_size_drop_oldest
steps.doc: Keep the buffer at most ``max_size`` by dropping the oldest transitions.

steps.name: sample_minibatch_from_buffer
steps.doc: Sample ``batch_size`` transitions uniformly (with replacement).

steps.name: build_target_network_copy
steps.doc: A detached copy of the parameters for the target network.

steps.name: compute_target_q_with_target_network
steps.doc: DQN targets: r + gamma * max_a Q_target(s') * (1 - done). Batched.

steps.name: sync_target_network_periodically
steps.doc: Every ``sync_every`` steps, copy the online params into the target net.

steps.name: train_dqn_agent
steps.doc: Train a DQN agent (X) vs a random opponent (O). Returns the online params.

steps.name: compare_dqn_tabular_random_minimax
steps.doc:
Win/loss/draw vs a random opponent for each agent (DQN, tabular, random).
Returns a dict keyed by agent name.

steps.name: sarsa_on_policy_update
steps.doc:
On-policy SARSA update: uses Q(s',a') for the action actually taken next,
not the max. Q <- Q + alpha*(r + gamma*next_q - Q).

steps.name: reinforce_log_prob_of_action
steps.doc: Log of the softmax probability assigned to ``action``.

steps.name: reinforce_collect_episode_returns
steps.doc: Discounted returns-to-go: G_t = sum_{k>=t} gamma^(k-t) * r_k.

steps.name: reinforce_policy_gradient_update
steps.doc:
Per-step gradient of the REINFORCE loss (-sum_t G_t log pi(a_t)) w.r.t. the
logits: G_t * (softmax(logits_t) - onehot(a_t)). Shape (T, num_actions).

steps.name: compare_value_vs_policy_learners
steps.doc:
Train a value-based (tabular Q-learning) and a policy-based (tabular
REINFORCE) agent, evaluate both vs random, and return {'value','policy'} stats.

steps.name: symmetry_augmented_training
steps.doc:
Q-learning that applies each update to all 8 symmetric (state, action) pairs,
learning ~8x faster per episode. Returns the Q-table.
